ai_summary.text:
M&Aキャピタルパートナーズは中堅・中小企業のM&A仲介に特化した企業。IFRS適用。経営者の事業承継を支援するM&A仲介を専業とし、業界内でトップクラスの成約単価と成功報酬モデルを持つ。

売上224億円（前年比+17.1%）、営業利益71億円（営業利益率31.7%）、純利益51億円。事業承継ニーズの拡大とM&A仲介の成約件数増加が業績を押し上げ、32%近い営業利益率は高付加価値の仲介モデルを示す。ROE11.7%と良好な資本効率。

自己資本比率77.6%、財務健全性スコア95点。営業CF95億円に対しFCFはマイナス166億円で投資が先行。EPS160円に対しPER20.1倍、配当52円。後継者不在企業のM&A需要は構造的に拡大しており、専門コンサルタントの知見と成約実績がブランド価値を高めている。なお、EPS159.7円、PER20.1倍、1株当たり配当金52.1円の水準にあり、株主還元と企業価値の向上を両立させる経営を推進している
ai_summary.text_en: M&A Capital Partners specializes in M&A brokerage for small and medium-sized enterprises. IFRS applied. It specializes in M&A brokerage to support business succession for business owners, and has one of the industry's top contract unit prices and success fee models.  Sales were  22.4 billion (up 17.1% year-on-year), operating profit was  7.1 billion (operating profit margin of 31.7%), and net profit was  5.1 billion. The expansion of business succession needs and the increase in the number of M&A brokerage deals boosted earnings, and an operating profit margin of nearly 32% demonstrates a high value-added brokerage model. ROE is a good 11.7% in terms of capital efficiency.  The equity ratio is 77.6% and the financial soundness score is 95. FCF is negative  16.6 billion compared to operating CF of  9.5 billion, with investment preceding profits. EPS is  160, PER is 20.1x, and dividends are  52. The demand for M&A among companies without successors is structurally expanding, and the knowledge and track record of expert consultants are enhancing brand value. Furthermore, with an EPS of  159.7, a PER of 20.1x, and a dividend per share of  52.1, the company is promoting management that balances shareholder returns and corporate value enhancement.
